shortDescription: The GE Profile™ Side-By-Side Refrigerator features a dual-dispense autofill pitcher and CustomSize™ Ice. The CustomSize™ Ice allows you to choose 8 different ice types via the SmartHQ app. The extra-large capacity, adjustable shelves and door bins give you plenty of room for all your groceries.

features.text: Hands-Free Autofill
Lets you walk away while the dispenser automatically fills any container with filtered water. Easily AutoFill popular 40 oz. tumblers with an 11-inch dispenser opening.
Customize™ Ice

Control your ice cube size in the second icemaker that is engineered to produce 8 different ice sizes, which flex from faster-chilling to slower-melting. Change your cube at any time via the SmartHQ™ app.
Dual Icemakers
Have plenty of filtered ice on hand with two icemakers located in the door, freeing up valuable space in the freezer. Dispense cubed or crushed ice through the door or use the included ice scoop.
LED Light Walls
The LED Light Walls are engineered to shed bright light throughout the fridge and freezer, illuminating every shelf and making even the smallest items easy to find.
Extra Large Storage Capacity
Maximize your food storage with 27.8 cubic feet of capacity; built to handle everything from everyday essentials to bulk grocery purchases.
Adjustable Glass Shelves

Utilize every inch of space with adjustable, full-width, glass shelves that extend from wall to wall. Easily reposition the height to fit a bottle of wine or even fit a 13x18 baking sheet, giving you flexible storage space right where you need it.
Extra-Large Adjustable Door Bins

The adjustable door bins with chrome accents can flex up and down to fit your needs, whether you need to move a tall item to the door, fit more than two gallons in a bin, or stock up on everyday essentials.
Slide-Out Storage Drawers

Keep your food organized with two, dedicated drawers in both the fridge and freezer sections. Ideal for separating produce, meats, frozen meals, and more, these drawers offer targeted storage and easy access so that everything has its place.
Multivent Cooling
Multiple vents distribute air flow to help keep set temperatures consistent.
Built-in Wifi, Powered by SmartHQ™ App

Control your CustomSize™ Ice, manage the dual icemakers, receive high temperature alerts, adjust temperature settings, get door alarm alerts, check your water filter status, adjust the LED Light Walls, set your Demand Response preferences, control your proximity lighting, and more.
Premium Ice and Water Filtration

The included refrigerator water filter is certified to reduce 70+ impurities including lead, chlorine, total PFAS, microplastics, and select pharmaceuticals. (Impurities not necessarily found in all users' water).
